transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, Batch B-72 — the 2,400 actuator brackets from yesterday's coating-line changeover — is currently held for disposition. The customer expects shipping to begin Thursday, so we need to move through this review efficiently but thoroughly. The batch has passed its routine visual inspection, but per our standard process, I need each function to report before we make a release decision. Let's go around the table: Quality, Process, Logistics, and Compliance — please share any finding that should affect our decision on this batch.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share a critical finding from the laboratory audit I completed this morning. Out of the 2,400 brackets in Batch B-72, 300 brackets have coating thickness below the 18-micron minimum specification. The remaining 2,100 brackets passed the thickness test. The signed laboratory report is still in document control and hasn't reached you yet, Mara, which is why I'm raising it now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a process finding to report. I conducted a process trial and confirmed that the 300 under-thickness brackets Jon just identified can be reworked on Cell 2. Cell 2 has capacity for exactly 300 brackets and requires exactly 5 hours of setup and rework time. I recorded the result in my engineering notebook, but I should note that the rework work order has not yet been opened.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a logistics finding to report. I confirmed with the customer freight desk today that the order must ship as exactly 1,800 brackets on Thursday and 600 brackets on Monday. I received this confirmation by email, but the transportation plan has not yet been updated to reflect this split.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a compliance finding to report. My customer-file review, completed yesterday, found that every shipped bracket requires a serialized traceability label and a lot-specific material certificate before dispatch. This is a mandatory customer requirement, but it is not yet reflected in our release checklist — so we need to ensure both are in place before any brackets ship on Thursday.
transcript.speaker: A5
